title: DR1 tells a user entering a transporter's phone number to include the country code if it is international; the frontend's phone field carries no hint, on a form whose whole point is that the transporter may be abroad.

finding.frontend: The private transporter form's phone field is labelled Telephone number and has no hint (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/transport/private-transporter-details/private-transporter-details.njk:73-81). The only rule on it is a 20-character maximum. A user entering a transporter based in Ireland, France or anywhere else the consignment starts gets no signal that a bare national number will not be dialable, and the field is on a form that offers a Country select precisely because the transporter is often not in the UK.
finding.prototype: DR1 hints the same field "For international numbers include the country code" (app/views/partials/transporter-add-private-fields.html:100-104). It sits under an "Enter contact details" heading with the email address, and the commercial add form carries the identical hint.
finding.difference: Add the hint to the private transporter form's phone field. One line of copy; no validation change is implied and none should be added on the strength of it, because DR1 does not validate the format either. If the add-commercial form is built later it takes the same hint.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding a country-code hint on the frontend's transporter phone field — the captured page model lists the field with a null hint.
